name: alterlab-rowan
description: Drives the Rowan cloud quantum-chemistry platform via its Python API for computational chemistry — pKa prediction, geometry optimization, conformer searching, molecular property calculations, protein-ligand docking (AutoDock Vina), and AI protein cofolding (Chai-1, Boltz-1/2), with cloud compute and no local setup. Use when running DFT or semiempirical methods, neural network potentials (AIMNet2), molecular property or protein-ligand binding predictions, or automated computational chemistry pipe
author: AlterLab-IEU
summary_zh: 通过 Python API 调用云端量子化学平台，适合免本地配置完成分子性质预测、结构优化和蛋白配体对接等计算化学任务。
